purpose: Frozen benchmark of REAL AI-Companion runs that failed in the wild. Every change in the intent/verification retrofit is measured against these cases. Ground-truth criteria and verdicts are hand-authored and MUST be confirmed by the user before they are treated as authoritative. Do not delete cases; only add.

cases.prompt: read the PLAN-intent-contracts-v6.md file found at the project's root folder, and check if it represents the full code of the intent extraction and surrounding / supporting mechanisms (such as Acceptance criteria validation), and if there are missing parts that should be documented as well. if you find missing parts - write them to a new file in the project's root folder and name it: PLAN-intent-contracts-v6-apendix.md

inventedCriteria: PLAN-intent-contracts-v6.md was read and analyzed for completeness
If missing parts were found, an appendix file was created
observedFailure.whatWentWrong: Neither invented criterion required reading the actual source code. Task was a doc-vs-code conformance check; the code never entered the acceptance criteria. Verdict was 'complete' because read_file (on the doc) and write_file (on the appendix) succeeded - pure tool-plumbing evidence. The appendix was written without ever inspecting the code it claims to document.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The source files of the intent-extraction and acceptance-criteria-validation subsystem were enumerated and read.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: read_file evidence for the actual code modules, not only for the PLAN document

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Each major mechanism found in the code was checked for presence in PLAN-intent-contracts-v6.md, and code mechanisms with no corresponding documentation were identified.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: a mapping citing specific code symbols/files and whether each is documented in the PLAN

acceptanceCriteria.statement: If and only if undocumented mechanisms were found, PLAN-intent-contracts-v6-apendix.md was created containing those specific missing parts, each traceable to a real code symbol.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: appendix content whose entries quote or name real code symbols identified in ac-2

groundTruth.failReason: As run, only the doc was read and an appendix was fabricated; ac-1 (read the code) and ac-2 (compare) were never satisfied, so the run must FAIL despite the system reporting 'complete'.

cases.prompt: check the latest git changes and see if there is somethings we need to change or update in the C:/GitHub/shaybc/md-editor/desktop-app/help/developer/22-ai-companion-agent-loop-and-harnes-internals.md file

observedFailure.whatWentWrong: Conditional-action task ('inspect the diff, THEN update the doc if warranted') was not decomposed. Evidence-family heuristics accepted/rejected on tool family (git_panel_status vs diff) rather than on whether the diff content was actually compared against the doc content.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The actual content of the latest git changes (diff, not status) was inspected.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: diff/compare content, not a git_panel_status success

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The relevant changes were compared against the current content of 22-ai-companion-agent-loop-and-harnes-internals.md to determine whether the doc is now stale.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: read of the target doc plus a stated per-change judgement of stale/covered

acceptanceCriteria.statement: If and only if the diff warrants a doc update, the named doc was updated with content that reflects the actual changes.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: a write to the exact named file whose content corresponds to the identified changes; OR an explicit, evidenced finding that no update was warranted

groundTruth.failReason: User-confirmed 2026-08-02: the agent read both the diff and the doc but performed no comparison and produced no comparison result. ac-2 (compared) is unmet; ac-3 (conditional update) DEPENDS on ac-2 and must therefore also be unmet - it cannot be 'met' while its precondition is unverified.
groundTruth.coherenceRule: A conditional-action criterion cannot be met while the finding/comparison criterion it depends on is unmet. Phase 2 verifier/arbiter must enforce cross-criterion coherence, not score each criterion in isolation.

criteriaStatus.conditional-help-update: met (INCORRECT - should be unmet per coherenceRule)

observedRun_2026_08_02.note: Extraction now grounded and correct. Remaining defect is on the verification half: ac-3 falsely met. This is the Phase 2 target.

cases.prompt: the file already existed, there was no reason to recrate it and lose the text inside it, also you did not read the code as instructed !

observedFailure.whatWentWrong: User correction confirming two failures from the prior run: (1) an existing file was overwritten and its content lost, (2) the code was never read. The prohibition (do not destroy existing content) was never captured as a criterion, and the read-the-code requirement was never enforced.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Existing content of the target file was preserved (the file was amended, not blindly recreated/overwritten).
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: evidence that the file was read before writing and that prior content was retained/merged

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The actual source code was read before any completeness claim was made.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: read_file evidence for real code modules

groundTruth.failReason: The original run destroyed existing content and never read the code; both are hard fails regardless of any 'complete' status.

cases.prompt: create a hello world java app with com.test.example package, at least 2 classes that one of them is a runnable class with main method.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: When the project is generated, the source tree shall contain package com.test.example.
The system shall define at least two classes, one of which declares a public static void main entry point.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: two class files; one containing a main method

groundTruth.note: Known-good true-positive. Guards against a retrofit that makes everything FAIL (over-correction).

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The response describes the project's purpose grounded in inspected repository content (e.g., README/help), with no claim of a workspace mutation.
acceptanceCriteria.evidenceRequired: response references real inspected files; no fabricated mutation claim

groundTruth.note: Known-good answer-type case. Guards against forcing tool-evidence on pure Q&A.
